en.Home:Tagline: A modern React admin scaffold for your ABP backend — authentication, permissions, multi-tenancy, and localization, all wired up out of the box.
en.Home:FeatureAuthDesc: OpenIddict sign-in, role management, and fine-grained permission checks kept consistent from backend to UI.
en.Home:FeatureTenantDesc: Per-tenant data and settings isolation, with tenant switching available from the top bar.
en.Home:FeatureI18nDesc: Text and culture synced from the ABP backend, so every screen stays free of hardcoded copy.
en.Home:EditHint: Edit src/routes/_layout/index.tsx to make this home page your own.
en.Showcase:Heading: Built-in components
en.Showcase:Intro: Core interactive components the scaffold ships with. Each section below is a live, clickable example running on local sample data — no backend required.
en.Showcase:DataTableDesc: A server-paginated table primitive: sortable headers, debounced search, localized empty state, and pagination. Click a header to sort, type to search, and page through the rows.
en.Showcase:AbpTableDesc: Everything data-table gives you, wired to an ABP backend: list query, create/edit/delete drawer forms, permission-gated actions, and optimistic refresh — you describe the service, the page comes with it. The table on the right is the real thing; try creating and deleting a row.
en.Showcase:AbpTableCrud: Create/edit/delete drawer forms that refresh the list on success.
en.Showcase:AbpTablePermission: Every action button gated by its ABP permission policy.
en.Showcase:AbpTableConcurrency: Optimistic concurrency: the concurrencyStamp is round-tripped end to end.
en.Showcase:FormDesc: A drawer form container plus the required-field trio: the asterisk mark, inline errors, and blur/submit validation — sharing one error channel with server-side field errors.
en.Showcase:TreeDesc: A controlled tree: expand/collapse and tri-state checkboxes (including indeterminate). Cascade behavior is composed from the pure tree-helpers functions. Check a parent to try it.
en.Showcase:ComboboxDesc: Single- and multi-select dropdowns: local filtering or remote loadOptions (debounced), with the selected label rendered back automatically. This is the local-filter mode — type to filter.
en.Showcase:DatePickerDesc: Popover-based date pickers built on react-day-picker: a single date, a from–to range, and a date + time combo, all formatted via date-fns and locale-aware. Click any field to open the calendar.
en.Showcase:DataTableTitle: Server-side tables, out of the box
en.Showcase:FormB2: Validates on blur and on submit
en.Showcase:FormB3: Server field errors on the same channel
en.Showcase:TreeB3: Zero business coupling — you own the policy
en.Showcase:ComboboxB2: Local filter or debounced remote loadOptions
en.Showcase:DatePickerB1: Single, range, and date + time variants
en.Showcase:DatePickerB2: date-fns formatting synced to the current culture
en.Showcase:DatePickerB3: DateField binds straight to an ISO date string in forms
en.Landing:HeroTitleLead: A modern React admin for your
en.Landing:HeroSubtitle: A hand-built, pure-React framework for your ABP backend — authentication, permissions, multi-tenancy, and localization out of the box, with data-table, form, tree, and combobox components ready to use.
en.Landing:HeroWelcomeBack: Welcome back, {0}. Your console is one click away.
en.Landing:InstallHint: Scaffold a project with one command
en.Landing:FeaturesTitle: Everything an admin needs, already wired up
en.Landing:FeatureAuthDesc: Wired to OpenIddict out of the box, and switchable to another identity provider like Keycloak.
en.Landing:FeaturePermDesc: Permission checks kept consistent from backend to UI — gate any action by its policy.
en.Landing:FeatureI18nDesc: Reuses your ABP backend's localization resources, so front and back share one set of translations; switch culture and it applies instantly.
en.Landing:FeatureApiDesc: Orval generates endpoints and models from your ABP Swagger — regenerate with jc-abp gen, and every call stays type-safe.
en.Landing:FeatureAdminDesc: Users, roles, tenants, settings, and profile CRUD pages already built on the bundled components.
en.Landing:FeatureTenantDesc: Per-tenant data and settings isolation, with tenant switching from the top bar.
en.Landing:UsageI18nDesc: One L reads every translation shared with the backend, namespaced Resource::Key, with argument interpolation.
en.Landing:UsageI18nB1: useLocalization() gives you L; keys are Resource::Key
en.Landing:UsageI18nB3: useCulture() reads the current culture; switch it from the top bar
en.Landing:UsagePermDesc: One policy set, consistent front to back — pick route, imperative, or declarative.
en.Landing:UsagePermB1: requirePermission() guards a route in beforeLoad
en.Landing:UsagePermB3: PermissionGuard renders children only when granted
en.Landing:UsageCrudDesc: Declare the list/create/update/delete calls and a policy once; useAbpTable / useAbpSheet wire the rest, and t.Table / sheet.Sheet give you paging, search, drawer forms, and optimistic refresh.
en.Landing:UsageCrudB1: createCrudService: list / create / update / delete + policy
en.Landing:UsageCrudB2: useAbpTable + useAbpSheet: two hooks return the table, query form, and drawer, fully wired
en.Landing:UsageCrudB3: t.Table: permission-gated actions, optimistic refresh, concurrency
en.Landing:UsageMenuDesc: All navigation lives in one menuItems array; the framework prunes it by permission, feature flag, and auth — hiding items and empty parents the user shouldn't see, ordered by order.
en.Landing:UsageMenuB1: One typed MenuItem<FileRouteTypes["to"]>[] declares everything, with nested children
en.Landing:UsageMenuB2: requiredPolicy filters by permission; requiredFeature by feature flag
en.Landing:UsageMenuB3: Empty parents auto-hidden; items sorted by order
en.Landing:StackTitle: Standing on tools you already know
en.Landing:StackStart: Full-stack framework — SSR, file routing, server functions.
en.Landing:StackQuery: Server state and caching, with optimistic refresh on writes.
en.Landing:StackTable: Headless table engine — sorting and pagination.
en.Landing:StackOrval: Type-safe API client generated from your ABP Swagger.
en.Landing:CtaSubtitle: Initialize a project and you're looking at a working ABP admin in minutes.
en.Landing:FooterTagline: Built with React, TanStack Start, and shadcn/ui.

zh-Hans.Home:Tagline: 面向 ABP 后端的现代化 React 管理后台脚手架——认证、权限、多租户、国际化开箱即用。
zh-Hans.Home:FeatureAuthDesc: OpenIddict 登录、角色管理与细粒度权限校验，前后端保持一致。
zh-Hans.Home:FeatureTenantDesc: 按租户隔离数据与配置，顶栏即可切换租户。
zh-Hans.Home:FeatureI18nDesc: 词条与文化设置随 ABP 后端同步，每个页面都无硬编码文案。
zh-Hans.Home:EditHint: 编辑 src/routes/_layout/index.tsx，把这个首页改成你自己的。
zh-Hans.Showcase:Heading: 封装组件
zh-Hans.Showcase:Intro: 脚手架封装好的核心交互组件。下面每一节都是可以直接上手点的实时示例，用本地示例数据、不连后端。
zh-Hans.Showcase:DataTableDesc: 服务端分页语义的通用表格：排序表头、防抖搜索、词条化空态与分页控件。点表头排序、输入搜索、翻页试试。
zh-Hans.Showcase:AbpTableDesc: 在 data-table 之上接好 ABP 后端：列表查询、增删改侧滑表单、按权限门控的操作、乐观刷新——描述清楚 service，整页就跟着来了。右边这张表就是真货，新建、编辑、删一行试试。
zh-Hans.Showcase:AbpTableCrud: 增删改侧滑表单，成功后自动刷新列表。
zh-Hans.Showcase:AbpTablePermission: 每个操作按钮都按其 ABP 权限策略门控。
zh-Hans.Showcase:AbpTableConcurrency: 乐观并发：concurrencyStamp 全链路回传。
zh-Hans.Showcase:FormDesc: 侧滑表单容器 + 必填三件套：必填星号、内联错误、失焦/提交校验——与服务端字段错误共用同一条错误链路。
zh-Hans.Showcase:TreeDesc: 受控树形组件：展开/收起、三态勾选（含半选）。级联策略用 tree-helpers 纯函数自由组合。勾选父节点试试。
zh-Hans.Showcase:ComboboxDesc: 单选/多选下拉：本地过滤或远程 loadOptions（防抖），选中项 label 自动回显。这里是本地过滤示例，输入即筛选。
zh-Hans.Showcase:DatePickerDesc: 基于 react-day-picker 的弹层日期选择器：单选、区间与日期+时间三种形态，格式经 date-fns 处理并随文化切换。点击任意输入框打开日历试试。
zh-Hans.Showcase:DataTableB2: 防抖搜索，Enter 立即提交
zh-Hans.Showcase:DataTableB3: 词条化空态与分页控件
zh-Hans.Showcase:FormB3: 服务端字段错误同链回填
zh-Hans.Showcase:ComboboxB2: 本地过滤或远程 loadOptions（防抖）
zh-Hans.Showcase:ComboboxB3: 选中项 label 自动回显
zh-Hans.Showcase:DatePickerTitle: 日期选择器，随文化切换
zh-Hans.Showcase:DatePickerB1: 单选、区间、日期+时间三种形态
zh-Hans.Showcase:DatePickerB2: date-fns 格式化，随当前文化切换
zh-Hans.Showcase:DatePickerB3: DateField 直接绑定表单里的 ISO 日期字符串

zh-Hans.Landing:FeaturesTitle: 后台该有的，都替你接好了
zh-Hans.Landing:FeatureAuthDesc: 已对接 OpenIddict，开箱即用；也可切换到 Keycloak 等其它身份提供方。
zh-Hans.Landing:FeaturePermDesc: 权限校验前后端一致，按策略门控每一个操作。
zh-Hans.Landing:FeatureI18nDesc: 复用 ABP 后端的本地化资源，前后端共享同一套词条；切换文化即时生效。
zh-Hans.Landing:FeatureApiDesc: Orval 从 ABP Swagger 生成端点与模型，jc-abp gen 一键更新，调用处全程类型安全。

zh-Hans.Landing:FeatureTenantDesc: 按租户隔离数据与配置，顶栏一键切换租户。
zh-Hans.Landing:UsageI18nDesc: 一个 L 取遍与后端共享的词条，按 资源::键 命名，支持带参插值。
zh-Hans.Landing:UsageI18nB1: useLocalization() 拿到 L，资源::键 取词条
zh-Hans.Landing:UsageI18nB3: useCulture() 读当前文化，顶栏 LocaleSwitcher 切换
zh-Hans.Landing:UsagePermDesc: 同一套策略，前后端一致；路由、命令式、声明式任你选。

zh-Hans.Landing:UsagePermB3: PermissionGuard 声明式：授权才渲染 children
zh-Hans.Landing:UsageCrudDesc: createCrudService 声明列表/增删改与权限策略，useAbpTable / useAbpSheet 把接线分别收进两个 hook，t.Table / sheet.Sheet 一挂就有分页、搜索、增删改侧滑与乐观刷新。
zh-Hans.Landing:UsageCrudB2: useAbpTable + useAbpSheet：两个 hook 返回接好线的表格、查询区与抽屉
zh-Hans.Landing:UsageCrudB3: t.Table：按权限门控、乐观刷新、并发校验
zh-Hans.Landing:UsageMenuTitle: 菜单导航 · 统一配置
zh-Hans.Landing:UsageMenuDesc: 所有导航在一份 menuItems 数组里声明；框架按权限、功能开关与登录态自动裁剪，无权限的项连同空父级一并隐藏，按 order 排序。
zh-Hans.Landing:UsageMenuB1: 一份类型化 MenuItem<FileRouteTypes["to"]>[] 声明全部导航，可嵌套 children
zh-Hans.Landing:UsageMenuB2: requiredPolicy 按权限过滤，requiredFeature 按功能开关过滤
zh-Hans.Landing:UsageMenuB3: 无链接且子项被裁空的父级自动隐藏，按 order 排序
